title: The Glow Below
blurb: Finn and Zeb dive into the dark sea to find out what is glowing below the boat.
cover_prompt: Finn in a blue wetsuit inside a small round yellow submarine pod with a big glass front and Zeb in a yellow wetsuit with mask, snorkel and torch, both heroic and smiling, underwater at night among hundreds of tiny glowing blue jellyfish, a friendly reddish octopus on the rocks beside them and the boat's hull on the moonlit surface above.

sound.label: /oa/
sound.intro: Listen for the /oa/ sound, as in boat. In this story it is spelt three ways. Tap a word to hear it.

cracked: The glow was hundreds of tiny jellyfish, and an octopus nearly kept Zeb's torch! Finn and Zeb cracked the case!

text: Finn and Zeb are in the Den. Ping!
A boat crew saw a glow in the sea at night.
p1.prompt: Inside the cosy explorer den, the wall screen shows a fishing boat at night on a dark sea with a mysterious soft blue glow in the water beneath it and a flashing alert; Finn studies the screen with a magnifying glass, Zeb holds up a snorkel.

text: Finn is the sea scientist. Zeb is the diver.
They load the boat and float out to sea.
p2.prompt: A small white and orange boat at a sunny harbour: Finn in a blue wetsuit loads a crate of gear while Zeb in a yellow wetsuit with a mask on his forehead carries flippers; a small round yellow submarine pod with a big glass front sits on the deck.

text: The sun goes down. The sea is like glass.
Then... a soft blue glow below the boat!
p3.prompt: Sunset over a calm glassy sea; the small boat drifts, Finn and Zeb lean over the side gazing down at a magical soft blue glow spreading in the dark water beneath them, their faces lit blue.

text: Zeb zips up his dive suit. Finn hops in
the pod. Slow and steady, says Finn.
p4.prompt: On the boat deck at dusk, Zeb in a yellow wetsuit with mask and snorkel and a small air tank zips up his suit and holds a torch, while Finn in a blue wetsuit climbs into the round yellow submarine pod with a big glass front, giving a thumbs up.

text: Down they go. Bubbles float up. The pod's
lights glow. Zeb gives a thumbs up: OK!
p5.prompt: Underwater in deep blue: Zeb in his yellow wetsuit and mask swims down with a torch, bubbles rising, giving an OK hand sign; beside him the round yellow pod with glowing headlights, Finn visible through its big glass front, smiling.

text: The glow goes two ways: along the rocks,
or down the slope. Which way, Zeb?
c1.prompt: Underwater at night: a trail of soft blue glow splits in two, one way along a rocky reef wall with corals, the other down a dark sandy slope into deeper water; Zeb the diver hovers at the fork with his torch, Finn in the pod points both ways.

text: Along the rocks, a crab blows bubbles.
A moray pokes its nose out. Hello!
b1a.prompt: Underwater along a colourful rocky reef: a cheerful orange crab blows a stream of bubbles, and a friendly green moray eel pokes its head out of a hole; Zeb the diver waves at it with his torch, the pod's lights glowing behind.

text: Down the slope it is dark and cold.
Zeb's torch shows a stone dome. A home?
b1b.prompt: Underwater down a dark sandy slope: Zeb the diver shines his torch on a strange dome made of neatly piled stones and shells on the seabed, with two curious eyes peeking from a gap; the yellow pod's lights glow behind him.

text: The glow is... hundreds of tiny jellyfish!
They flash blue as they float past. Wow!
p6.prompt: Underwater at night: hundreds of tiny glowing blue jellyfish drift past in a magical sparkling cloud; Zeb the diver floats among them in wonder, Finn presses his face to the glass of the yellow pod, everything lit in soft blue light.

text: Then a stone moves. An octopus!
It has no bones. It can hide in a tiny hole.
p7.prompt: Underwater near the rocks: a big reddish octopus unfolds from what looked like a stone, one arm squeezing out of a tiny hole in the rock; Zeb the diver jumps back in surprise with his torch, the pod's lights on the scene.

text: It goes pink, then brown, then white!
An octopus can change its coat to hide.
p8.prompt: Underwater: the same octopus shown rippling through colours, its skin half pink, half brown, fading to white against the pale rock; Zeb the diver watches amazed close by, Finn in the pod holds up a camera.

text: The octopus grabs Zeb's torch with one arm!
What should they do?

reveal.text: Divers say octopuses are clever and curious, and they like to grab new things. Stay calm and never pull. Most let go in the end. But would you wait, or swap?

c2.prompt: Underwater: the octopus has wrapped one long arm around Zeb's glowing torch and is tugging it; Zeb holds the other end with a surprised face, Finn in the yellow pod has his hands on the glass; the torch beam swings across the water.

text: Zeb lets go. The octopus pokes the torch.
Not food! It drops it and slides away.
b2a.prompt: Underwater: Zeb the diver lets go and floats back with open hands while the octopus pokes and prods the glowing torch with its arms, then drops it and jets away in a puff of bubbles; the torch sinks gently to the sand.

text: Finn slowly holds out a shell. The octopus
takes it and lets the torch go. A swap!
b2b.prompt: Underwater: the yellow pod's little robot arm holds out a pretty spiral shell; the octopus reaches for the shell with one arm and releases the glowing torch with another; Zeb catches the torch, Finn grins through the glass.

text: They float and wait. The octopus gets
bored and slides back into its hole.
b2c.prompt: Underwater: Zeb the diver and the yellow pod hover patiently with calm faces while the octopus, looking bored, drops the torch and slides itself back into a tiny hole in the rock, one eye still peeking out.

text: A turtle glides past, slow and calm.
It goes up for a breath, then back to doze.
p9.prompt: Underwater in the blue night sea: a big green sea turtle glides slowly past Zeb the diver and the yellow pod, heading up towards the moonlit surface for a breath; Zeb waves, the turtle looks calm and friendly.

text: Air is low. Time to go up, slowly.
Up the rope, or ride the pod?
c3.prompt: Underwater: Zeb the diver checks a small gauge on his tank, looking up; beside him a thick rope hangs down from the boat far above on the moonlit surface, and the yellow pod waits with its hatch open and Finn beckoning.

text: Zeb goes up the rope, hand over hand.
The glow fades. The moon is out. Hello!
b3a.prompt: Zeb the diver climbs slowly up a rope through the dark blue water towards the shimmering moonlit surface, hand over hand, bubbles rising; the glow of the jellyfish fades below; the yellow pod rises beside him with Finn waving.

text: Zeb hops in the pod. Up they float,
past the glow, up to the moonlit boat.
b3b.prompt: Finn and Zeb both inside the round yellow pod, faces at the big glass front, as it floats up through the sparkling blue jellyfish glow towards the boat's hull silhouetted against the moonlit surface above.

text: On the boat, Finn writes: the glow is tiny
jellyfish! Case cracked! Zeb is snoring.
p10.prompt: On the boat deck under a big full moon, Finn in his blue wetsuit writes in a notebook showing a drawing of glowing jellyfish with a big tick, while Zeb, still in his yellow wetsuit, is fast asleep and snoring on a coil of rope with his torch in his hand.

casefile.title: Giant Pacific octopus
casefile.subtitle: Three hearts, eight arms, no bones.

facts.text: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.
Each arm has about 200 suckers. Eight arms makes about 1,600 suckers, more than all the children in a big school.
A big one is 4 metres from arm tip to arm tip, as long as a car.

casefile.prompt: A Creature Cases style fact file portrait of a giant Pacific octopus, reddish-orange with big curious eyes, arms curling among rocks and corals on the seabed with a few glowing blue jellyfish drifting above; clean, bright, centred, like a collector card illustration, no text.

quiz.why: Hundreds of tiny jellyfish, flashing blue.

quiz.q: What colours did the octopus go?
quiz.why: It changes its coat to hide.

quiz.q: Why did the turtle go up to the top?
Why can an octopus hide in a tiny hole?
quiz.why: No bones, so it can squeeze into tiny gaps.

debrief.question: What would you swap with the octopus to get the torch back?
